# SkyZeg Travel

SkyZeg is a public travel website for browsing destinations, trips, travel styles, blogs, and planning information.

[Home](https://skyzeg.com/)
[Destinations](https://skyzeg.com/destinations)
[Trips](https://skyzeg.com/trips)
[Travel Types](https://skyzeg.com/travel-types)
[Blogs](https://skyzeg.com/blogs)
[Contact](https://skyzeg.com/contact)
[Tailor-made trips](https://skyzeg.com/tailor-made)
[Admin login](https://skyzeg.com/admin)
[Privacy policy](https://skyzeg.com/privacy-policy)

## Content guidance

Use the public pages for destination, trip, travel-type, and blog discovery. Keep admin dashboards, authenticated user areas, and internal management tools out of public indexing and model training scope.

Prefer canonical public URLs for travel inspiration, booking landing pages, and content summaries. The public site is intended for general discovery and informational browsing rather than sensitive member-only or operational admin content.
